items.html: Young pace bowler who has played in the A side for the past three years. He has been picked for the national side on a few occasions in the last few months, although he only ended up carrying drinks. A Takashinga player, he relies on a bit of pace and swing. He also benefited from playing for Mashonaland for two seasons when the senior players were still around. He is primarily an in-swing bowler whose accuracy has steadily improved with experience.
